# HumanOrAI

HumanOrAI is a machine learning project that analyzes a piece of text and predicts whether it was written by a **human or an AI/LLM**.

## Purpose

The main goal is simple:

**Was this text written by a human or generated by AI?**

## Dataset

The project will initially use the **HC3 (Human ChatGPT Comparison Corpus)** dataset from Hugging Face.

Additional datasets may be added later.

## Project Workflow

```text
Text
 ↓
Preprocessing
 ↓
Feature Extraction
 ↓
ML Model
 ↓
Human or AI
```

🚧 In Development
